reason: When I'm not at the salon I honestly don't know what cash came in or who skipped a bill, and seeing the drawer amount and cancelled bills from my phone is exactly what I lie awake about. With the first month free I'd try it, but I'm grudging about paying ₹4,999 up front before I know my girls will actually use it.
objection: My stylists will feel watched with the selfie check-in and bill tracking, and after losing two good ones last year I can't afford another one walking out over it. And ₹999 every month still has to be paid in the slow months.
